height.$description: A small button's height. It follows the density setting through size/control-sm.

gap.$description: Between a small button's icon and its label.

padding-inline.$description: Beside a small button's label, before the density step (--but-density-padding), which every app adds.

icon-only-padding-inline.$description: Beside a small button's icon when it has no label. The button is 2px wider than tall.
